final: WITH g AS (SELECT a.translink AS l, t.tradekind AS k, COUNT(*) AS c FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord r ON r.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = r.trdref GROUP BY a.translink, t.tradekind), s AS (SELECT k, SUM(c) AS sm FROM g GROUP BY k), rt AS (SELECT g.l, g.k, g.c, g.c * 1.0 / s.sm AS ratio FROM g JOIN s ON s.k = g.k), av AS (SELECT k, AVG(ratio) AS a FROM rt GROUP BY k), kept AS (SELECT rt.k, rt.c, rt.ratio, rt.ratio - av.a AS d FROM rt JOIN av ON av.k = rt.k WHERE rt.ratio > av.a) SELECT k AS tradekind, AVG(c) AS avg_count, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(d) AS avg_diff FROM kept GROUP BY k
